name: Mathematical Objective Obfuscation via Binomial Sum Swap
description: The original metric evaluates to sum(b_j * 4^(n-j)). The model recognized this positional dominance and used an ascending-color DFS that stops at the first valid coloring. I replaced the subset-based definition with an equivalent double summation involving binomial coefficients and powers of 3. Unless the model analytically swaps the summation order (or writes code to precompute the coefficients of each band), it will not realize the metric is positionally dominating (lexicographical). A naive branch-and-bound will fail to prune early and will TLE on large sparse graphs.
